text:
Maria Gomez: quick favor — can someone run a mixed-quant bench for redwood-13B-v2 comparing int4-only, int8-only, and hybrid int4+FP8? target seq=2048, batch=1 and batch=8, promptset="instruct-sweep-200". Need throughput, p50/p95/p99 latency, and quality (exact eval diffs). Looking for regressions <1% but want numbers to decide tradeoffs.
Josh Patel: on it. do you want opt1 kernels or opt2?
Maria Gomez: opt2 preferred as prod-like, but include opt1 for baseline.
Liam O'Neill: I'll queue perf-ci. exact command?
Maria Gomez: something like:
```
bench_runner --model redwood-13B-v2 --quant [int4,int8,int4-fp8] --kernels [opt1,opt2] --seq 2048 --batches [1,8] --prompts instruct-sweep-200 --warmup 200 --runs 500 --capture-traces
```
Liam O'Neill: perfect. I'll split into 6 jobs (3 quant x 2 kernels) and tag with `mixbench-1767`.
Anya Chen: pinging perf-bot to queue and watch.
perf-bot: queued jobs: mixbench-1767-001 .. mixbench-1767-006. estimated runtime ~2h. logs will be at /artifacts/mixbench-1767/ (will update when done).
Josh Patel: note — make sure KV cache warmup is included for seq=2048. set `--prefill 512` so tail behavior is realistic. Also capture token distribution and memory GC logs.
Carla Rivera: add p50/p95/p99 + 95% CI for throughput please. Also capture sample generations for the promptset for human inspection.
Ben Hart: if quality drop >0.8% on any quantization, run extended eval with 1k prompts. otherwise we might be chasing noise.
Liam O'Neill: jobs started. I'll post individual job IDs in a sec.
perf-bot: started mixbench-1767-001 (int4,opt2,batch1) job_id=pb-9283
perf-bot: started mixbench-1767-002 (int8,opt2,batch1) job_id=pb-9284
perf-bot: started mixbench-1767-003 (int4-fp8,opt2,batch1) job_id=pb-9285
perf-bot: started mixbench-1767-004 (int4,opt1,batch8) job_id=pb-9286
perf-bot: started mixbench-1767-005 (int8,opt1,batch8) job_id=pb-9287
perf-bot: started mixbench-1767-006 (int4-fp8,opt1,batch8) job_id=pb-9288
Maria Gomez: thx. small ask — capture raw logits for one run of each job for layerwise analysis.
Josh Patel: will add `--dump-logits layerwise` to the remaining queue.
Liam O'Neill: early results in /artifacts/mixbench-1767/partial/ — posting summary (opt2, batch1):
- int4: throughput=42 tok/s, p50=75ms, p95=220ms, p99=430ms, quality_drop=0.6%
- int8: throughput=31 tok/s, p50=110ms, p95=310ms, p99=600ms, quality_drop=0.1%
- int4-fp8(hybrid): throughput=55 tok/s, p50=60ms, p95=180ms, p99=360ms, quality_drop=1.3%
Carla Rivera: hmm hybrid looks great for latency but quality_drop 1.3% is above threshold. need layer analysis.
Ben Hart: agree — 1.3% > 0.8% trigger. run longer eval on hybrid (1k prompts) before discarding. also check per-prompt failure modes (hallucinations, truncations).
Maria Gomez: good catch. Josh — can you run a layerwise FP8 mask sweep? toggle FP8 on top N layers (N=2,4,8,16) and re-eval.
Josh Patel: on it. scheduling 4 quick sweeps.
Liam O'Neill: added traces and raw logits to /artifacts/mixbench-1767/logs/; also captured memory patterns during runs.
perf-bot: mixbench-1767 jobs complete: all OK. artifacts: /artifacts/mixbench-1767/final.tar.gz
Josh Patel: preliminary layer-sweep (opt2, batch1):
- FP8 top2 layers: throughput=53 tok/s, quality_drop=0.9%
- FP8 top4 layers: throughput=54 tok/s, quality_drop=0.95%
- FP8 top8 layers: throughput=55 tok/s, quality_drop=1.1%
- FP8 top16 layers: throughput=55.5 tok/s, quality_drop=1.25%
Carla Rivera: pattern suggests most of degradation comes from middle layers 20-30. can we try FP8 on all except those?
Ben Hart: also sanity-check tokenizer edgecases — some prompts with long code blocks show more drops. add a filter to eval to see distribution by prompt type.
Maria Gomez: proposal: roll hybrid with FP8 on top 4 + bottom 4 layers, keep middle in int4 — run AB eval. If quality delta <=0.8% and latency >25% improvement we can consider canary.
Josh Patel: I'll run that config today. Liam will you collect traces/p99 outlier logs?
Liam O'Neill: yup. I'll also attach hot kernel call stacks.
Carla Rivera: once Josh has AB results, let's schedule a short async review thread with screenshots of sample generations.
Maria Gomez: deadline: post AB results and artifact link by EOD PST. thanks all :thumbsup:
Ben Hart: noted. assigning action items — Josh: layer-sweep AB, Liam: traces + extended eval artifacts, Carla: sample review & prompt-type breakdown.
Anya Chen: I'll update the perf board and add a follow-up ticket (RUN-4823).
Maria Gomez: amazing. keep updates short here. :sparkles:
